column2: Open Figma bugs per catalog section, joined through routes.tsv (app=main).
Bug data: 603 open reports (status new/needs_info, figma_link set),
harvested 2026-08-11. Regenerate with: node hotspots.mjs
Matched 603/603. A bug route matches the MOST SPECIFIC owning route,
so /play/scratchers lands on skratch rather than play, and a :param segment
matches exactly one url segment so /crypto/TOADUS lands on /crypto/:symbol.
A previous version inferred ownership from the route column of individual
status.<section>.tsv rows and reported a triumphant 603/603 that was
FALSE: "/" has zero path segments, so a prefix test made it a catch-all that
silently swallowed /launchpad and /sports. 100% here is only meaningful
because every route below is declared explicitly in routes.tsv.
